```{r}
# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================
`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
}

build_plain_bundle <- function(
  name,
  outcome,
  train_raw,
  prep_rec,
  final_fit
) {
  x_cols <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    names()

  list(
    name = name,
    outcome = outcome,
    model_type = "plain",
    train_raw = train_raw,
    prep_rec = prep_rec,
    x_cols = x_cols,
    final_fit = final_fit
  )
}

build_umap_hdb_bundle <- function(
  name,
  outcome,
  train_raw,
  prep_rec,
  final_fit,
  umap_model_file,
  hdb_fit,
  z_train,
  umap_n_components,
  umap_n_neighbors,
  umap_min_dist = 0.1,
  umap_metric = "euclidean",
  umap_seed = NA_integer_
) {
  x_cols <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    names()

  list(
    name = name,
    outcome = outcome,
    model_type = "umap_hdb",
    train_raw = train_raw,
    prep_rec = prep_rec,
    x_cols = x_cols,
    final_fit = final_fit,
    umap_model_file = umap_model_file,
    hdb_fit = hdb_fit,
    train_umap_features = as.matrix(z_train),
    umap_colnames = colnames(z_train),
    umap_settings = list(
      n_components = umap_n_components,
      n_neighbors = umap_n_neighbors,
      min_dist = umap_min_dist,
      metric = umap_metric,
      seed = umap_seed
    )
  )
}

add_hdbscan_features <- function(train_umap, test_umap, outcome, minPts = 10) {
  x_train <- train_umap %>% select(-all_of(outcome))
  x_test  <- test_umap  %>% select(-all_of(outcome))

  hdb_fit <- dbscan::hdbscan(
    as.matrix(x_train),
    minPts = minPts
  )

  test_cluster <- predict(
    hdb_fit,
    newdata = as.matrix(x_test),
    data = as.matrix(x_train)
  )

  levs <- sort(unique(c(hdb_fit$cluster, test_cluster)))

  train_hdb <- train_umap %>%
    mutate(
      hdb_cluster = factor(hdb_fit$cluster, levels = levs),
      hdb_noise = factor(if_else(hdb_fit$cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                         levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
    )

  test_hdb <- test_umap %>%
    mutate(
      hdb_cluster = factor(test_cluster, levels = levs),
      hdb_noise = factor(if_else(test_cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                         levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
    )

  list(
    train = train_hdb,
    test = test_hdb,
    fit = hdb_fit
  )
}

drop_bad_predictors <- function(train_df, test_df, outcome, id_col = "peiid", drop_cols = NULL) {
  train_df <- train_df %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))
  test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))

  train_df <- train_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
  test_df  <- test_df  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

  char_preds <- names(train_df)[vapply(train_df, is.character, logical(1))]
  char_preds <- setdiff(char_preds, c(id_col, outcome))

  if (length(char_preds) > 0) {
    train_df <- train_df %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
    test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
  }

  pred_names <- setdiff(names(train_df), c(id_col, outcome))
  one_val <- pred_names[
    vapply(train_df[pred_names], function(x) length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 1, logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(one_val) > 0) {
    train_df <- train_df %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
    test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
  }

  list(train = train_df, test = test_df)
}

fit_rf_direct <- function(train_df, test_df, outcome, id_col = "peiid",
                          trees = 1500, grid_levels = 4,
                          metric_for_best = "bal_accuracy") {

  outcome_sym <- rlang::sym(outcome)
  form <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ ."))

  rec <- recipe(form, data = train_df) %>%
    update_role(all_of(id_col), new_role = "id") %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

  prep_rec <- prep(rec, training = train_df, retain = TRUE)

  x_train <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_df) %>%
    select(-all_of(c(outcome, id_col)))

  p <- ncol(x_train)
  min_class_n <- train_df %>%
    count(!!outcome_sym) %>%
    summarise(min_n = min(n)) %>%
    pull(min_n)

  v <- min(5, min_class_n)

  rf_spec <- rand_forest(
    trees = trees,
    mtry = tune(),
    min_n = tune()
  ) %>%
    set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
    set_mode("classification")

  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(rf_spec) %>%
    add_recipe(rec)

  min_class_n <- train_df %>%
  count(!!outcome_sym) %>%
  summarise(min_n = min(n)) %>%
  pull(min_n)
  
  v <- min(5, min_class_n)
  
  if (v < 2) stop("At least one class has <2 training samples.")
  
  folds <- vfold_cv(train_df, v = v, strata = !!outcome_sym)

  grid <- grid_regular(
    mtry(range = c(1, min(10, p))),
    min_n(range = c(2, 20)),
    levels = grid_levels
  )

  tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = folds,
    grid = grid,
    metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)
  )

  best <- select_best(tuned, metric = metric_for_best)

  final_fit <- finalize_workflow(wf, best) %>%
    fit(train_df)

  pred <- predict(final_fit, test_df, type = "prob") %>%
    bind_cols(predict(final_fit, test_df, type = "class")) %>%
    bind_cols(test_df %>% select(all_of(outcome)))

  list(
    recipe = rec,
    prep_rec = prep_rec,
    tuned = tuned,
    best = best,
    final_fit = final_fit,
    pred = pred
  )
}

fit_xgb_direct <- function(train_df, test_df, outcome, id_col = "peiid",
                           metric_for_best = "bal_accuracy",
                           grid_size = 25) {

  outcome_sym <- rlang::sym(outcome)
  form <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ ."))

  rec <- recipe(form, data = train_df) %>%
    update_role(all_of(id_col), new_role = "id") %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

  prep_rec <- prep(rec, training = train_df, retain = TRUE)

  baked_train <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_df) %>%
    select(-all_of(c(outcome, id_col)))

  folds <- vfold_cv(train_df, v = 5, strata = !!outcome_sym)

  xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
    trees = tune(),
    tree_depth = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    min_n = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    mtry = tune(),
    stop_iter = 25
  ) %>%
    set_engine("xgboost") %>%
    set_mode("classification")

  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(xgb_spec) %>%
    add_recipe(rec)

  params <- parameters(
    trees(range = c(500L, 2500L)),
    tree_depth(range = c(2L, 8L)),
    learn_rate(range = c(-3, -0.5)),
    loss_reduction(range = c(-3, 1)),
    min_n(range = c(2L, 20L)),
    sample_prop(range = c(0.5, 1.0)),
    finalize(mtry(), baked_train)
  )

  grid <- grid_latin_hypercube(params, size = grid_size)

  tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = folds,
    grid = grid,
    metrics = metric_set(bal_accuracy, kap, accuracy)
  )

  best <- select_best(tuned, metric = metric_for_best)

  final_fit <- finalize_workflow(wf, best) %>%
    fit(train_df)

  pred <- predict(final_fit, test_df, type = "prob") %>%
    bind_cols(predict(final_fit, test_df, type = "class")) %>%
    bind_cols(test_df %>% select(all_of(outcome)))

  list(
    recipe = rec,
    prep_rec = prep_rec,
    tuned = tuned,
    best = best,
    final_fit = final_fit,
    pred = pred
  )
}
```

```{r}

set.seed(1)

df_order <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(taxorder = factor(taxorder)) %>%
  mutate(taxorder = fct_lump_min(taxorder, min = 15, other_level = "Other")) %>%
  filter(taxorder != "Other") %>%
  droplevels()

split_order <- initial_split(df_order, prop = 0.8, strata = taxorder)
train_order <- training(split_order)
test_order  <- testing(split_order)

rec_order <- recipe(taxorder ~ ., data = train_order) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean","taxonname_key","taxclname",
    "taxsuborder","taxgrtgroup","taxpartsize",
    "taxsubgrp","taxsubgrp_clean",
    "taxsubgrp_mod1","taxsubgrp_mod2","taxsubgrp_mod3",
    "taxsubgrp_mod_group","taxgrtgroup_mod_group","taxsuborder_mod_group"
  ))) %>%
  step_rm(starts_with("mod_"), starts_with("is_")) %>%
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01) %>%
  step_indicate_na(all_of(c(
    "cec7_w",
    "pct_hz_with_cec7",
    "min_cec_per_kg_clay_0_150",
    "median_cec_per_kg_clay_bt_zone"
  )), prefix = "na2_") %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_mutate_at(
    all_of(c(
      "sandy_mantle_cm",
      "plinthite_thickness_cm","plinthite_overlap_0_150_cm",
      "bt_thickness_cm","argillic_thickness_cm","argillic_contiguous_max_cm"
    )),
    fn = ~ pmax(.x, 0)
  ) %>%
  step_log(all_of(c(
    "sandy_mantle_cm",
    "plinthite_thickness_cm","plinthite_overlap_0_150_cm",
    "bt_thickness_cm","argillic_thickness_cm","argillic_contiguous_max_cm"
  )), offset = 1) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec_order <- prep(rec_order)

x_train_order <- bake(prep_rec_order, new_data = train_order) %>%
  select(-taxorder, -peiid) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

x_test_order <- bake(prep_rec_order, new_data = test_order) %>%
  select(-taxorder, -peiid) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

x_train_order[!is.finite(as.matrix(x_train_order))] <- 0
x_test_order[!is.finite(as.matrix(x_test_order))] <- 0

set.seed(2)
umap_fit_order <- uwot::umap(
  as.matrix(x_train_order),
  n_components = 10,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  ret_model = TRUE
)
umap_fit_gg <- uwot::umap(
  as.matrix(x_train_gg),
  n_components = 15,
  n_neighbors = 10,
  min_dist = 0.01,
  metric = "euclidean",
  ret_model = TRUE
)
z_train_order <- as.data.frame(umap_fit_order$embedding)
z_test_order <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test_order), umap_fit_order))
names(z_train_order) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train_order)))
names(z_test_order)  <- names(z_train_order)

train_umap_order <- bind_cols(z_train_order, taxorder = train_order$taxorder)
test_umap_order  <- bind_cols(z_test_order,  taxorder = test_order$taxorder)

hdb_order <- add_hdbscan_features(
  train_umap = train_umap_order,
  test_umap = test_umap_order,
  outcome = "taxorder",
  minPts = 10
)

rf_order_spec <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1000,
  mtry = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_order <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_order_spec) %>%
  add_formula(taxorder ~ .)

set.seed(3)
folds_order <- vfold_cv(hdb_order$train, v = 5, strata = taxorder)

grid_order <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, min(12, ncol(hdb_order$train) - 1))),
  min_n(range = c(2, 25)),
  levels = 5
)

tuned_order <- tune_grid(
  wf_order,
  resamples = folds_order,
  grid = grid_order,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap)
)

best_order <- select_best(tuned_order, metric = "kap")

rf_final_order <- finalize_workflow(wf_order, best_order) %>%
  fit(hdb_order$train)
uwot::save_uwot(
  umap_fit_order,
  file = "../outputs/models/taxorder_rf_umap_hdb_umap.uwot"
)
pred_order <- predict(rf_final_order, hdb_order$test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(rf_final_order, hdb_order$test, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(hdb_order$test %>% select(taxorder))


taxorder_bundle <- build_umap_hdb_bundle(
  name = "taxorder_rf_umap_hdb",
  outcome = "taxorder",
  train_raw = train_order,
  prep_rec = prep_rec_order,
  final_fit = rf_final_order,
  umap_model_file = "../outputs/models/taxorder_rf_umap_hdb_umap.uwot",
  hdb_fit = hdb_order$fit,
  z_train = z_train_order,
  umap_n_components = 10,
  umap_n_neighbors = 15,
  umap_min_dist = 0.1,
  umap_metric = "euclidean",
  umap_seed = 2
)
taxorder_bundle$umap_model_file <- "../outputs/models/taxorder_rf_umap_hdb_umap.uwot"
taxorder_bundle$metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
  pred_order,
  truth = taxorder,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

taxorder_bundle$f_meas <- f_meas(
  pred_order,
  truth = taxorder,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  estimator = "macro"
)

taxorder_bundle$conf_mat <- conf_mat(
  pred_order,
  truth = taxorder,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

saveRDS(
  taxorder_bundle,
  "../outputs/models/taxorder_rf_umap_hdb_bundle.rds"
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(51)

df_so <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    taxsuborder = str_squish(as.character(taxsuborder)),
    taxsuborder = na_if(taxsuborder, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxsuborder)) %>%
  mutate(taxsuborder = factor(taxsuborder)) %>%
  mutate(taxsuborder = fct_lump_min(taxsuborder, min = 15, other_level = "Other")) %>%
  filter(taxsuborder != "Other") %>%
  droplevels()

split_so <- initial_split(df_so, prop = 0.8, strata = taxsuborder)
train_so <- training(split_so)
test_so  <- testing(split_so)

clean_so <- drop_bad_predictors(
  train_df = train_so,
  test_df = test_so,
  outcome = "taxsuborder",
  id_col = "peiid",
  drop_cols = c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
    "taxorder", "taxgrtgroup", "taxsubgrp",
    "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3",
    "taxpartsize"
  )
)

res_so <- fit_rf_direct(
  train_df = clean_so$train,
  test_df = clean_so$test,
  outcome = "taxsuborder",
  id_col = "peiid"
)
taxsuborder_rf_bundle <- build_plain_bundle(
  name = "taxsuborder_rf_plain",
  outcome = "taxsuborder",
  train_raw = clean_so$train,
  prep_rec = res_so$prep_rec,
  final_fit = res_so$final_fit
)

taxsuborder_rf_bundle$metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
  res_so$pred,
  truth = taxsuborder,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

taxsuborder_rf_bundle$f_meas <- f_meas(
  res_so$pred,
  truth = taxsuborder,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  estimator = "macro"
)

taxsuborder_rf_bundle$conf_mat <- conf_mat(
  res_so$pred,
  truth = taxsuborder,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

saveRDS(
  taxsuborder_rf_bundle,
  "../outputs/models/taxsuborder_rf_plain_bundle.rds"
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(11)

df_gg <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(taxgrtgroup = factor(taxgrtgroup)) %>%

  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder",
    "taxsubgrp", "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3",
    "taxpartsize"
  ))) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# after baking

  select(-taxgrtgroup, -peiid)

x_test_gg  <- x_test_gg  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

# keep numeric only

x_test_gg  <- x_test_gg  %>% select(where(is.numeric))

# replace NA / NaN / Inf for UMAP safety

  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))

stopifnot(sum(is.na(x_test_gg)) == 0)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(as.matrix(x_train_gg))))

test_umap_gg  <- bind_cols(z_test_gg,  taxgrtgroup = test_gg$taxgrtgroup)

  umap_n_neighbors = 10,
  umap_min_dist = 0.01,
  umap_metric = "euclidean",
  umap_seed = 140
)
pred_gg_xgb <- predict(xgb_final_gg, hdb_gg$test, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(xgb_final_gg, hdb_gg$test, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(hdb_gg$test %>% select(taxgrtgroup))
taxgrtgroup_bundle$metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
  pred_gg_xgb,
  truth = taxgrtgroup,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

taxgrtgroup_bundle$f_meas <- f_meas(
  pred_gg_xgb,
  truth = taxgrtgroup,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  estimator = "macro"
)

taxgrtgroup_bundle$conf_mat <- conf_mat(
  pred_gg_xgb,
  truth = taxgrtgroup,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

saveRDS(
  taxgrtgroup_bundle,
  "../outputs/models/taxgrtgroup_xgb_umap_hdb_bundle.rds"
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(61)
```

```{r}
set.seed(41)
```

```{r}
model_files <- list.files("../outputs/models", pattern = "_bundle\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

model_objs <- lapply(model_files, readRDS)

ncss_metric_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(model_objs, function(x) {

  met_tbl <- if (!is.null(x$metrics)) {
    x$metrics %>%
      dplyr::select(.metric, .estimate) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)
  } else {
    tibble(
      accuracy = NA_real_,
      kap = NA_real_,
      bal_accuracy = NA_real_
    )
  }

  f1_tbl <- if (!is.null(x$f_meas)) {
    x$f_meas %>%
      dplyr::select(f_meas_macro = .estimate)
  } else {
    tibble(f_meas_macro = NA_real_)
  }

  bind_cols(
    tibble(
      model = x$name %||% NA_character_,
      outcome = x$outcome %||% NA_character_
    ),
    met_tbl,
    f1_tbl
  )
})

ncss_metric_summary
beepr::beep("wilhelm")
```
```{r}
model_files <- list.files("../outputs/models", pattern = "_bundle\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
model_objs <- lapply(model_files, readRDS)

bundle_check <- purrr::map_dfr(model_objs, function(x) {
  tibble(
    name = x$name %||% NA_character_,
    outcome = x$outcome %||% NA_character_,
    model_type = x$model_type %||% NA_character_,
    has_prep_rec = !is.null(x$prep_rec),
    has_final_fit = !is.null(x$final_fit),
    has_metrics = !is.null(x$metrics),
    has_f_meas = !is.null(x$f_meas),
    has_conf_mat = !is.null(x$conf_mat),
    has_umap_fit = ifelse((x$model_type %||% "") == "umap_hdb", !is.null(x$umap_fit), NA),
    has_hdb_fit = ifelse((x$model_type %||% "") == "umap_hdb", !is.null(x$hdb_fit), NA)
  )
})

bundle_check
```
